tickets.title: Bring up the docker-compose stack and run the spec 07 validation runbook
tickets.body:
Bring up the docker-compose stack (16 services) and execute the validation runbook in specs/07-deployment-docker.md sec7.

- cp .env.example .env (fill FERNET_KEY, MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD)
- docker compose up -d --build
- docker compose ps: all healthy; mc/provision exited 0
- connectors RUNNING; topics mysql.shop.orders / mysql.shop.customers exist

Owner: poc-orchestrator. Ref: specs/07 sec7, STATE.md sec3.

tickets.title: Validate CDC hop lineage end-to-end (MySQL -> Debezium -> Kafka -> Marquez)
tickets.body:
Validate the CDC hop lineage end-to-end:

- Insert a row into MySQL (:13306) and read it back from topic mysql.shop.orders (console consumer)
- Marquez UI http://localhost:3000: lineage mysql://mysql:3306/shop.orders -> debezium.shop-orders:mysql.0 -> kafka://kafka:9092/mysql.shop.orders; run RUNNING; schema facet
- Validate bring-up risks from reports/cdc-openlineage-review.md: Marquez/Nessie healthcheck tooling, OL SMT schema facet (envelope vs after), Connect image <-> OL core version lockstep (3.6.2.Final)

Owner: debezium-expert. Ref: specs/03, specs/07 sec7, reports/cdc-openlineage-review.md.

tickets.title: Switch Airflow + Spark OpenLineage transports from console to Marquez
tickets.body:
Switch the Airflow + Spark OpenLineage transports from console to Marquez when those hops are implemented:

- AIRFLOW__OPENLINEAGE__TRANSPORT -> {"type":"http","url":"http://marquez:5000","endpoint":"api/v1/lineage"} (compose + dags inline conf)
- spark.openlineage.transport.type=http, url=http://marquez:5000 (spark-defaults.conf)

Owners: airflow-expert, iceberg-expert. Ref: specs/06 ticket T-01, specs/04/05.

tickets.title: Align Airflow Kafka dataset namespace to kafka://kafka:9092
tickets.body:
Align Airflow-declared Kafka dataset namespace to kafka://kafka:9092 (currently bare 'kafka') so Airflow and Spark hops join in Marquez. Update dags/ inlets + spec 04.

Owner: airflow-expert. Ref: specs/06 ticket T-02, specs/02 joining rules, OQ7.

tickets.title: Implement Airflow -> Spark -> Iceberg hop end-to-end
tickets.body:
Implement the Airflow -> Spark -> Iceberg hop end-to-end:

- Run DAGs load_orders / load_customers (SparkSubmitOperator, cluster mode)
- Spark apps read Kafka (from_avro), transform, MERGE into nessie.poc.shop_orders / shop_customers
- capture_snapshot reads back the Iceberg snapshot id
- OpenLineage events from Airflow + Spark into Marquez (depends on T-01)

Owners: airflow-expert, iceberg-expert. Ref: specs/04, specs/05, dags/, spark-apps/.

tickets.body:

tickets.title: Downgrade spec 04 §3 snapshot-id wording to 'records in Airflow run metadata' (OQ13)
tickets.body:
Downgrade the spec 04 §3 wording that 'attaches it as the output version marker' to 'records in Airflow run metadata' — the snapshot id is recorded in Airflow run metadata, not attached as an output version marker (OQ13). Update spec 04.

Owner: airflow-expert. Ref: specs/06 OQ13, specs/04.

tickets.title: Close out HOP-01 review drifts (D2/D4/D6/D8/P1/P2/D9) + fix sync-tickets.ps1
tickets.body:
Close out the non-test follow-ups from the HOP-01 review (reports/airflow-spark-iceberg-review.md) and the sync-tickets.ps1 script bugs (STATE.md sec 3 item 4).

Scope (design/authoring only - no bring-up, no testing):

1. sync-tickets.ps1 fixes (pm-agent): gh issue close/reopen aborts under $ErrorActionPreference="Stop" (native stderr -> NativeCommandError); New-Issue ignores manifest status: closed; --sync/--list/--close args don't bind in PS 5.1 -File invocation; document -Mode <mode> usage (script header, TICKETS.md, STATE.md).

2. D2 (airflow-expert): AIRFLOW_USERNAME/AIRFLOW_PASSWORD are not consumed by the official apache/airflow image; switch compose + spec 07 to _AIRFLOW_WWW_USER_USERNAME/_AIRFLOW_WWW_USER_PASSWORD (defaults admin/admin).

3. D4 (iceberg-expert): pin unpinned versions - minio/mc:latest, pyiceberg, apache-airflow-providers-apache-spark, apache-airflow-providers-openlineage (Dockerfile.airflow), fastavro + requests (Dockerfile.spark). Update STATE.md pins + spec 05/07 tables.

4. D6 (poc-orchestrator): add mc (service_completed_successfully) to spark-master depends_on so the bucket exists before Spark DDL; update spec 07 sec 6 + spec 05 sec 6.

5. D8 (iceberg-expert): rename from_avro UDF to confluent_from_avro in both Spark apps (avoids shadowing Spark's builtin from_avro); update Dockerfile.spark comment + specs 01/03/06 + STATE.md references. Reports stay as historical snapshots.

6. P1 (iceberg-expert): add the OQ5 "downstream of the UDF" qualifier to Step-4 comments in both apps (exact only for the declarative SELECT after deserialization).

7. D9 (iceberg-expert): annotate spec 05 sec 5 Nessie commit-hash + writer-metadata facets as deferred (not captured in the POC); align spec 06 risk row + spec 02 enrichment note.

8. P2 (lineage-designer): add spec 06 risk row documenting the kafkaOffset facet as a degenerate [0,end] cumulative re-scan (earliest->latest per run), accepted for the POC.

9. Doc drift (poc-docs-writer): spec 06 follow-up ticket table lists T-03/T-04 as Open; they are closed (#7/#8).

Deliverables: one commit per task per agent, each referencing CLN-01; tickets.json/TICKETS.md updated; board synced; STATE.md updated; pushed to origin/main.

tickets.title: Final runbook reconciliation: G3 envelope wording + load_customers coverage
tickets.body:
Final authoring reconciliation before the execution phase (no bring-up, no testing):

1. CDC review G3 (reports/cdc-openlineage-review.md): spec 07 sec 7 step 7 wording "schema facet shows the columns" under-describes the envelope shape - the Kafka dataset facet is the full CDC envelope (columns nested under after); the MySQL input dataset shows them flat. Align with spec 02's schema-facet nuance (G1, OQ4).

2. Runbook completeness: spec 07 sec 7 step 10 only triggers load_orders, but the acceptance criteria reference both poc.shop_orders and poc.shop_customers. Add load_customers coverage (trigger + Marquez chain check) so both DAGs are exercised.

Deliverables: one commit per task per agent referencing CLN-02; STATE.md updated; pushed to origin/main.
